decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series extends the firm's established physical-media and in-house label expertise, so it can interpret collector demand and refine the line, though such limited-run pressings may naturally rotate out even without any internal R&D.

The German new wave compilation series sits close to the firm's curated catalog and label know-how, letting it read early sales and extend the series, so dropping it within a year is unlikely despite the absence of formal research activity.
